description: ZTPHY is the coin of ZETAPHY, a post-quantum EVM chain (chain 3659). This token is ZTPHY bridged to {chain} by Saphan: each token is backed one to one by ZTPHY locked in its own vault on ZETAPHY, with daily caps, delays and a 48-hour timelock. ZETAPHY mainnet runs on a single validator and the bridge contracts have no external audit yet.
